# Tales From A Lazy Fat DBA

> > A database administration blog focused on Oracle, PostgreSQL, Golden Gate, and Data Guard with practical tutorials and certification insights.

FatDBA.com is a technical blog by a database administrator covering Oracle (11g, 21c), PostgreSQL, Apache Cassandra, Golden Gate, and Data Guard. The site features hands-on guides, troubleshooting tutorials, and professional certification experiences for database professionals.

## Key Topics

- Oracle Database
- PostgreSQL
- Oracle Data Guard
- Golden Gate
- Database Administration
- Oracle 21c
- Oracle 11g
- Data Guard Broker
- Transaction Wraparound
- pg_cron
- Apache Cassandra
- SYSAUX Tablespace
- Standby Database
- Azure Fabric Migration
- Database Certification

## PostgreSQL Guides

- [pg_cron: Probably the best way to schedule jobs within PostgreSQL database](https://fatdba.com/2021/07/30/pg_cron-probably-the-best-way-to-schedule-jobs-within-postgresql-database): PostgreSQL job scheduling with pg_cron extension installation guide
- [How to simulate the deadly 'Transaction Wraparound Problem' in PostgreSQL](https://fatdba.com/2021/07/20/how-to-simulate-the-deadly-transaction-wraparound-problem-in-postgresql): PostgreSQL transaction wraparound simulation and troubleshooting guide
